articles.headline: T'Vondre Sweat placed on injured reserve with knee injury
articles.description: The Jets will be without T'Vondre Sweat for at least the next four games, as the starting nose tackle was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a knee sprain.
articles.headlineJa: T'Vondre Sweat、膝の負傷により負傷者リスト入り
articles.descriptionJa: ジェッツは、スターティング・ノーズタックルのT'Vondre Sweatを欠くことになる。土曜日に膝の捻挫により負傷者リストに登録されたため、少なくとも今後4試合は欠場する見込みだ。
articles.body:
FLORHAM PARK, N.J. -- The New York Jets will be without T'Vondre Sweat for at least the next four games, as the starting nose tackle was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a knee sprain.

The good news for Sweat is that it's not considered a season-ending injury, a source said. The 366-pound run stuffer will be eligible to return Nov. 29 against the Miami Dolphins.

Sweat already had been ruled out for Sunday against the Las Vegas Raiders (3-4) at MetLife Stadium. His injury, which occurred last Sunday, comes at an inopportune time for the Jets, who have been struggling to stop the run. They're allowing 127.7 yards per game, 24th in the NFL.

Rookie Darrell Jackson Jr., a fourth-round pick from Florida State, is expected to replace Sweat in the lineup.

The Jets (2-5), losers of two straight, don't expect to have rookie edge rusher David Bailey (groin), who is doubtful for the game. To replace Sweat and Bailey on the game-day roster, they brought up Payton Page (signed to the roster) and Quinton Bell (elevation) from the practice squad, respectively.

The Jets are thin at defensive tackle. They're already down David Onyemata (core muscle surgery), who was placed on IR in Week 3.

Sweat was acquired in an offseason trade with the Tennessee Titans. After missing a chunk of training camp with a hamstring injury, he has appeared in all seven games, with no sacks, two tackles-for-loss and 17 total tackles.

articles.headline: Source: Commanders DT Daron Payne suffered season-ending foot injury
articles.description: Commanders defensive tackle Daron Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in practice Friday, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者：コマンドーズのDTダロン・ペイン、足の負傷で今季絶望
articles.descriptionJa: コマンドーズのディフェンシブタックル、ダロン・ペインが金曜日の練習中にジョーンズ骨折を負い、今季絶望となった。ESPNのアダム・シェフターが関係者の話として伝えた。
articles.body:
ASHBURN, Va. -- Washington Commanders defensive tackle Daron Payne suffered a season-ending Jones fracture in practice Friday, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

The injury occurred late in a light practice, during a team drill, according to a team source. It was described as a fluke injury, not resulting from anyone stepping on his foot during a play.

Payne will be placed on injured reserve and calls his future in Washington into question. He's in the final year of his contract and turns 30 in May. A typical recovery for such an injury could take up to four months, according to medical experts. Payne is the Commanders' longest-tenured position player.

It's a tough blow for Washington (1-4-1) which plays the Eagles (2-5) Sunday night. The Commanders will already be without starting end Javon Kinlaw, out Sunday with a knee injury. They do have depth at the position with veterans Charles Omenihu and Deatrich Wise Jr. End Jer'Zhan Newton, a second-round pick in 2024, returned to practice this week after suffering a torn pectoral muscle during a preseason game on Aug. 14. He's listed as questionable for Sunday.

But Payne has been a longtime starter for Washington. In fact, he started every game between 2020 and '24 as well as the first six games this season. He missed only two games in 2025.

Payne made the Pro Bowl in 2022 when he recorded a career-best 11 sacks -- six more than his second best season. He had one sack this year but was averaging a career-best 2.8 pass rush wins per game according to Tru Media.

Washington drafted Payne in the first round of the 2018 draft and signed him to a four-year extension in March of 2023.

articles.headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
articles.description: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.
articles.headlineJa: パトリオッツ、ドルフィンズ戦でA.J.ブラウンとトレベイオン・ヘンダーソンを欠場
articles.descriptionJa: パトリオッツのワイドレシーバー、A.J.ブラウンが日曜日のドルフィンズ戦を欠場することが決まった。また、No.2ランニングバックのトレベイオン・ヘンダーソンも体調不良により欠場となる。
articles.body:
FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's road game against the Miami Dolphins, the team announced Saturday.

Brown had a knee issue flare up this week, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness, according to the team. Henderson missed practice on Thursday and Friday.

The Patriots have one open spot on their 53-man roster and also could elevate up to two players from the practice squad by Saturday's 4 p.m. ET deadline. Fourth-year receiver Ryan Miller and first-year running back Lan Larison, both on the practice squad, are among the top candidates to be added to the game-day roster.

As for Brown, he was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, and later that day, his designation on the injury report had changed. It noted the knee issue, in addition to the right high ankle sprain sustained in the season opener that had landed him on injured reserve.

"Just wasn't able to finish practice on Wednesday, so we continue to treat him," coach Mike Vrabel said Friday.

Prior to that practice, Brown acknowledged he was still managing the ankle injury and didn't have his trademark explosiveness on an every-play basis. But Brown made it clear he wasn't making excuses, adding, "None of that stuff matters. I'm out here, so I'm going."

The Patriots had Brown going as if he had never been sidelined due to the ankle injury sustained in the season opener. In his first action since being designated to return from IR on Oct. 14, Brown played 102 out of a possible 122 snaps in a win over the New York Jets on Oct. 18 and a loss to the Chicago Bears on Oct. 22.

He admitted the stretch of two games in five days was "a lot for anyone" and appreciated "the couple [extra] days [off] on the back end." He had expressed hope Wednesday he would have a full week of practice and "try to put my best foot forward on Sunday [in Miami]."

Then came the knee flare-up, which leaves the Patriots thin at receiver with DeMario "Pop" Douglas, Kyle Williams and Efton Chism III the only healthy receivers on the 53-man roster.

Vrabel said the team's approach with Brown in the two games, and the injury that led him to miss Sunday's game, are "separate issues here."

Asked about the heavy workload for Brown, and if he would have benefited from fewer snaps, Vrabel said: "We want our best players to play and we consider him one of those."

Meanwhile, with Henderson out, the Patriots currently have just Rhamondre Stevenson and Corey Kiner as running backs on the 53-man roster.

articles.headline: Oliver Glasner: Nottingham Forest need major changes or 'sixth manager will come in'
articles.description: A furious Oliver Glasner said he could walk away from Nottingham Forest unless the club make major changes following their latest defeat.
articles.headlineJa: オリバー・グラスナー：「ノッティンガム・フォレストは抜本的な改革をすべきだ。さもなければ6人目の監督が来ることになる」
articles.descriptionJa: 直近の敗戦を受け、激昂したオリバー・グラスナーは、クラブが大幅な改革を行わない限り、自身はノッティンガム・フォレストを去る可能性があると語った。
articles.body:
A furious Oliver Glasner suggested he could walk away from Nottingham Forest unless the club make major changes following their latest defeat.

A freak own goal from Nikola Milenkovic and Igor Thiago's late strike left Forest second from bottom in the Premier League after a 2-0 loss at Brentford.

Former Crystal Palace boss Glasner was appointed as Forest's fifth head coach in less than a year at the start of the season, but the Austrian warned the club could soon be looking for a sixth unless a "s--- situation" improves.

"Just talking about the result today, and it's disappointing and frustrating. And we have to accept it's not good enough," he said.

"If you lose four of the last five games, it's not good enough. And that's why for me, it's now time that we change things, that I change things, and that's what I will do.

"I feel I could see a few things from day number one. I feel now maybe I made too many compromises in some stuff. And it's always compromises. It's a clear way. I will tell what we want to do, what we have to do.

"And if the players buy in, I think we can have a turnaround. And if not, the sixth manager will come in.

"I have no consequences. I think you see that. For me, I go home and have breakfast with my family.

"Nobody needs to have pity with Oliver Glasner. If I want, I could start in two weeks somewhere else. I won't do it. But the players, the staff, they remain in the same situation.

"And it's the same, sorry for the word, s--- situation that the club had last year. So you need to change and rebuild from the bottom to the top.

"And this is clear for me. And this is what I will do. And without any compromises. Zero, zero.

"And if these things don't work, they will let me know."

Victory ended Brentford's four-match winless run in what was the 100th Premier League game at the Gtech Stadium, and left them sitting pretty in sixth.

Boss Keith Andrews said: "I think it's our best win of the season. You have to show different traits to other matches we've played this season.

"This opposition and how they play, how they set up to try to condense the pitch, they test you in different ways. There was a lot of smart play and leadership from our players, which I liked.

"On so many levels I think it's a brilliant win."

articles.headline: Harry Kane misses penalty as Bayern Munich draw with Borussia Dortmund
articles.description: Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane missed a penalty as Bayern Munich were held by Der Klassiker rivals Borussia Dortmund in a 2-2 draw at the Allianz Arena.
articles.headlineJa: ハリー・ケインのPK失敗、バイエルン・ミュンヘンはボルシア・ドルトムントと引き分け
articles.descriptionJa: アリアンツ・アレーナで行われた「デア・クラシカー」のライバル、ボルシア・ドルトムントとの対戦において、バロンドール受賞者のハリー・ケインがPKを失敗し、バイエルン・ミュンヘンは2-2の引き分けに終わった。
articles.body:
Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane could not add a team victory to personal glory as he missed a penalty before Bayern Munich were held by Der Klassiker rivals Borussia Dortmund in a 2-2 Bundesliga draw at the Allianz Arena.

Konrad Laimer gave Bayern a 38th-minute lead moments after Jobe Bellingham had a goal ruled out for Dortmund.

On the hour mark Kane was handed a chance to cap an historic week, which started in London on Monday with him being named the best player in the world, with a goal when he won a spot-kick, but instead he missed it and Serhou Guirassy promptly levelled.

Dayot Upamecano soon restored the Bavarians' advantage as Kane made amends for his rare inaccuracy from 12 yards with an invaluable assist.

However, substitute Fábio Silva ensured the miss would ultimately hurt Bayern's bid to pull clear at the top as he preserved Dortmund's unbeaten status and joint leadership of the Bundesliga table with a last-gasp goal.

There was bad news for Bayern as Ballon d'Or nominee Michael Olise, midfielder Ismael Saibari and forward Serge Gnabry went off injured.

Saibari was helped off the field by two members of Bayern's medical staff after injuring his right leg in a collision with Dortmund goalkeeper Gregor Kobel. Saibari had a shot saved as he went one-on-one with Kobel and they tangled as Saibari challenged the diving Kobel for the rebound.

Saibari was holding his knee with a pained expression as Bayern medical staff manipulated his ankle. He limped off with the staff supporting him. 

Two minutes after Saibari was replaced by Nathaniel Brown, Gnabry went off, too. The forward sat down on the field in clear discomfort but was able to walk off unaided as Josip Stanisic replaced him.

Late in the game, forward Olise lay down off the ball with his hands covering his face and signalled for a substitution. He seemed in discomfort as he walked off.

Bayern were without head coach Vincent Kompany after he was released from hospital this week following treatment for an infection.

Forward Luis Díaz didn't play following a thigh issue against Arsenal last week, and Jonas Urbig started in place of Manuel Neuer in goal because Neuer has a foot problem.

Bayern face Atletico Madrid in the Champions League on Tuesday.

Information from the Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: Tottenham's resurgence continues with win over 10-man Crystal Palace
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur made it three Premier League wins in a row for the first time in 20 months with a comfortable 2-0 victory over 10-man Crystal Palace.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナム、10人となったクリスタル・パレスに勝利し復活の勢い継続
articles.descriptionJa: トッテナム・ホットスパーは、10人となったクリスタル・パレスを2-0で快勝し、プレミアリーグで20ヶ月ぶりに3連勝を達成した。
articles.body:
Resurgent Tottenham Hotspur made it three Premier League wins in a row for the first time in 20 months with a comfortable 2-0 victory over 10-man Crystal Palace.

Buoyed by only a second triumph at Chelsea in 36 years last weekend, Spurs' task was made more routine by a 13th-minute red card for Palace forward Jean-Philippe Mateta for a studs-up tackle on Micky van de Ven.

VAR intervened to assist referee Michael Oliver and it was largely one-way traffic after with Archie Gray able to open the scoring with a header after 25 minutes.

Roberto De Zerbi's team started the second half impressively and eventually doubled their lead with 17 minutes left through former Brighton centre-back Jan Paul van Hecke.

It allowed De Zerbi to hand a league debut to Spurs' teenager Luca Williams-Barnett on an enjoyable night for the north London club, but this latest defeat will increase the scrutiny on under-fire Palace boss Pierre Sage.

James Maddison was available for Spurs but De Zerbi decided to put the playmaker on the bench after his injury scare at Chelsea, with Dominic Solanke recalled in attack.

Palace boss Sage had eased speculation over his future with a midweek Carabao Cup win at Fulham, but the visitors' task in north London was made more difficult in the 11th minute.

Tottenham captain Van de Ven showed his pace to nip in ahead of Mateta, who caught the Dutch defender with a studs-up tackle on the Achilles, and while referee Oliver initially gave out a yellow card, it was soon upgraded to a red after a VAR review.

After a bright start for Palace, where Daichi Kamada had tested Antonín Kinsky early on, it was now an uphill battle for Sage's men.

Two excellent crosses by Mathys Tel failed to find a Tottenham player soon after, but the deadlock was broken in the 25th minute.

Mohammed Kudus sent in a dangerous corner kick to the back post where Gray headed in his third goal for Spurs and second against Palace.

Home fans chanted about Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane with 28 minutes on the clock, but without his predatory instincts it stayed 1-0 until half-time, with a powerful Omar Marmoush shot blocked by Axel Disasi.

Pedro Porro was introduced for Gray at the break to continue his comeback from a hamstring injury and Tottenham started the second half with improved intent.

Fernandes had a volley blocked by Dwight McNeil before a smart shot on the turn by Solanke was saved by Henderson.

Solanke was replaced by Conor Gallagher minutes later and after Tel sent another effort off target, Andy Robertson was denied by Henderson from close range.

It felt a matter of time until Spurs grabbed a second and it eventually arrived when Fernandes produced a sensational cross for Van Hecke, who had his initial header tipped on to the crossbar by Henderson and managed to bundle in whilst laying on the floor in the 73rd minute.

articles.headline: NFL to review additional allegations against Packers RB Josh Jacobs
articles.description: The NFL said it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Packers RB Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.
articles.headlineJa: NFL、パッカーズのRBジョシュ・ジェイコブスに対する追加の疑惑を調査へ
articles.descriptionJa: NFLは、ホーバート／ローレンス警察署の公開記録を通じて明らかになった、パッカーズのRBジョシュ・ジェイコブスによる身体的および言葉による虐待の追加疑惑について調査を行うと表明しました。
articles.body:
The NFL said Saturday it will look into additional allegations of physical and verbal abuse by Green Bay Packers running back Josh Jacobs that were revealed as part of a public records release from the Hobart/Lawrence Police Department.

The allegations, released Friday night in response to a public records request, show that three women alleged abuse by Jacobs to the department in incidents dating back to April 2021. The women came forward after learning of Jacobs' arrest in connection with an alleged domestic violence incident in May. 

"We will review these allegations as part of the investigation which has remained open," the NFL said in a statement.

Along with the allegations made by the three women, police released reports from the investigation as well as body camera and police dash camera footage from Jacobs' arrest. He pleaded no contest to misdemeanor counts of battery and criminal damage to property.

"The Brown County District Attorney's office had these uncorroborated, old, and previously unreported allegations for months," Jacobs' attorneys, David Z. Chesnoff, Richard A. Schonfeld and Clarence F. Duchac III, said in an emailed statement Saturday. "They conducted their own exhaustive investigation, along with the police department, and the D.A. determined that only two misdemeanor charges were warranted. They then entered into a plea agreement with Josh Jacobs. Josh has repeatedly expressed his remorse and is honoring the terms of the agreement."

In the 129-page report of the incident released Friday night -- some of which was heavily redacted -- the woman making the initial accusations against Jacobs told police he "looked like a different person" during the alleged battery and said he attempted to strangle or suffocate her two times. She told police it was the first time he had ever strangled or suffocated her.

In the report, police wrote that she "described Joshua's demeanor as 'enraged' and said she thought she was going to die."

A 911 call from the May 23 incident released by police Friday evening showed yelling in the background by a male, but no one spoke with police before the line was disconnected. Police were then dispatched to the address about a possible disturbance.

The woman alleged the incident began when she accused Jacobs of speaking with other women. When the woman tried to leave the home, the report alleged, Jacobs would initially not let her, broke her phone and eventually grabbed her by the neck in the garage and slammed her to the ground, hitting her head on the concrete floor and causing her to lose consciousness. When she woke up, the report claimed she told police it was hard for her to walk, she had blurry vision and she was "seeing dots/stars" in her vision.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Man City slip up vs. Brighton, Spurs win third straight
articles.description: There were plenty of treats in store on Halloween, from Chelsea beating United to City slipping to Spurs winning again. Relive all the action with ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグまとめ：マン・シティがブライトンに足元をすくわれる、スパーズは3連勝
articles.descriptionJa: チェルシーのユナイテッド撃破から、シティの失速、そしてスパーズの連勝まで、ハロウィンの夜には見どころ満載の展開となりました。ESPNで全アクションを振り返りましょう。
articles.body:
Happy Halloween! It's the final day of October, and there was plenty of exciting matches across Europe.

In the Premier League's early game, Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 as Lisandro Martinez conceded a penalty and was sent off to pile more pressure on head coach Michael Carrick.

In the highlight of the midday fixtures, two in-form sides in Manchester City and Brighton & Hove Albion met just three days after their Carabao Cup encounter, but this time, it was the Seagulls coming out victorious with a 1-0 win. When Tottenham Hotspur hosted Crystal Palace in a London derby, it was Spurs who came out on top with a 2-0 victory.

Elsewhere across Europe, Atlético Madrid beat Levante in LaLiga, while the Bundesliga served up a blockbuster Der Klassiker between league leaders Bayern Munich, led by newly crowned Ballon d'Or winner Harry Kane, and second-placed Borussia Dortmund, in which the pair fought valiantly to a 2-2 draw.

Relive all the action from Saturday's matches with ESPN.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United look to Fulham's Bassey to bolster defense
articles.description: Fulham captain Calvin Bassey has caught Man United's eye as the Red Devils weigh up strengthening their defense. Transfer Talk has the latest.

articles.body:
Manchester United could use an upgrade in defense, and Fulham captain Calvin Bassey has caught their attention, while Barcelona midfielder Fermín López is an option to replace Red Devils captain Bruno Fernandes. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Manchester United are looking to bolster their defense in the January and have interest is in Fulham's Calvin Bassey, according to TEAMtalk. Bassey, 26, has been in good form this season and was made Fulham captain. United will also be targeting a new left back and striker, after injuries to Luke Shaw, Patrick Dorgu and Benjamin Sesko, says The Times. Previous reports have linked the club with Newcastle United's Lewis Hall and AFC Bournemouth's Adrien Truffert, while up front Galatasaray's Victor Osimhen, Leeds' Dominic Calvert-Lewin and Crystal Palace's Jean-Philippe Mateta have also been mentioned.

- Manchester United want to bring in Barcelona midfielder Fermín López, says The Daily Mail. United are reported to be in the market for a new No. 10, with the future of 32-year-old captain Bruno Fernandes up in the air after his public falling out with manager Michael Carrick. Lopez, 23, has had a good start to the season with five goals and four assists, and is considered an option, alongside Atletico Madrid's Pablo Barrios. Lopez missed Spain's World Cup triumph with a foot injury, but Barcelona would want around €80 million to let him go, with Paris Saint-Germain and Chelsea also interested.

- Arsenal are interested in a loan move for Real Madrid striker Endrick in January, says TEAMtalk. The Gunners already have Kai Havertz and Viktor Gyökeres up front, but have struggled to score goals this season and the versatile Brazil international, 20, has not had many minutes under Jose Mourinho this season. Mourinho is reported to want Endrick to stay, but his representatives are exploring options for a move.

- Barcelona will renew their interest in signing Inter Milan defender Alessandro Bastoni in January, says Mundo Deportivo. Bastoni, 27, was being tracked by Barcelona scouts with a view to the club making a €70 million offer last summer, but terms could not be agreed and the Italy international stayed put.

- Barcelona and Atletico Madrid will fight for the signature of Manchester United defender Lisandro Martínez, as he is set to leave the club on a free transfer at the end of the season. AS claims that Martinez, 28, who criticized the Old Trafford hierarchy over transfer planning recently, has no future at United and could depart in January if clubs are willing to pay a small fee.

- Real Madrid attacking midfielder Alberto Ruiz, 15, has caught the eye of Man United after he helped Spain win the U15 World Cup. (AS)

articles.headline: Lakers' Jeanie Buss accuses siblings of 'cloak and dagger' tactics
articles.description: Jeanie Buss accused her siblings of conspiring against her in court filings responding to her siblings' ongoing effort to sell their shares in the Lakers.
articles.headlineJa: レイカーズのジーニー・バス、兄弟らの「隠密な」策動を非難
articles.descriptionJa: ジーニー・バスは、レイカーズの株式売却を進める兄弟らに対し、自身に対して共謀していると法廷文書で非難した。
articles.body:
In a court filing this week, Jeanie Buss accused her siblings of conspiring against her in a "cloak and dagger" campaign through the media, said they were jealous that their father picked her over them to govern the Los Angeles Lakers and asked a judge to block her siblings' attempt to sell the family's shares in the team, which would end her run as the Lakers' governor.

Wednesday's filing, reviewed by ESPN, is the latest salvo in the bitter legal battle playing out between Jeanie and her siblings, namely Joey and Jesse Buss, leading up to a scheduled Dec. 8 hearing in Los Angeles Superior Court.

The filing responds to recent filings by Jeanie's siblings, who are seeking to sell the family's remaining shares of the Lakers to the Bob Iger and Josh Kushner ownership group, who are seeking to buy the team from Mark Walter at a $12.5 billion valuation.

"The conflicts that ensued after Dr. [Jerry] Buss's death [in 2013] were sadly inevitable, and no doubt intensified given that Dr. Buss chose his daughter over four sons to be his successor," Jeanie's lawyers wrote in the Wednesday filing.

"Respondents' obsession with tearing down Jeanie and their inability to accept that she would be a part of the Lakers' future is borne of this classic succession parable."

In 2025, Walter bought a majority stake in the Lakers from the Buss family at a $10 billion valuation. During that sale, the Buss family retained a 17.82% stake, just above the NBA's 15% minimum for the family to retain control. The family also received go-along rights. On Aug. 17, ESPN's Shams Charania reported that Johnny, Jim, Janie, Joey and Jesse Buss had voted to sell the remaining family shares to Iger and Kushner using those go-along rights.

Each sibling stands to make an additional $371 million if the family sells the entirety of its shares via the go-along provision.

Jeanie has attempted to block those attempts to sell, saying that her siblings must obey a 2017 court order that required the two co-trustees, Janie and Joey, to always vote to ensure she remained the controlling owner of the team.

In Wednesday's filing, she again asked the court to remove Joey and Janie as co-trustees of the trust for breach of fiduciary duty, to hold them in contempt of court, to find Jim, Johnny and Jesse liable for aiding and abetting a violation of the 2017 court order, and for her to be reimbursed for legal costs.

Sources close to the family have told ESPN that there have been settlement talks between the two sides, but it's unclear how much progress has been made leading up to the scheduled December hearing.

"Jeanie had no choice but to seek court intervention to enforce the clear terms of the trust and this court's 2017 order," Wednesday's filing states. "Respondents respond [by] casting themselves as victims, when in reality, the entire episode is their own false flag operation.

Official Sunday inactives should begin coming in approximately 90 minutes before the scheduled kickoff times: around 11:30 a.m. ET for the early games and 2:30 p.m. ET for the late-afternoon games.

Refresh often for the latest information.

Don't forget to check these out: Mike Clay's Playbook | Week 8 Buzz 

Week 8 Rankings | Matchup rankings for Week 8

Biggest concerns ahead of Sunday

Players with early starts

Jeremiyah Love, RB, Cardinals (ankle): The rookie returned to practice this week and will play in Week 8. Fantasy managers should start him against a Cowboys team that allows the fifth-most rushing yards per game and eighth-most fantasy PPG to RBs.

Lamar Jackson, QB, Ravens (ankle): The two-time MVP, who has missed the past three games, was a full participant at practice this week. He will play in Week 8. With Jackson suiting up, you play him in fantasy for what could be the highest-scoring game of the week.

Dalton Kincaid, TE, Bills (chest): Kincaid is questionable headed into Week 8 against the Ravens. Coming off the bye and practicing this week, he seems more likely to play than not. He could be involved with the highest-scoring game of the week, which puts Kincaid in play as a low-end E1. If he plays, use him over Mark Andrews, Tyler Higbee and other streaming options.

DJ Moore, WR, Bills (shoulder): Moore has been limited at practice but is on the right side of questionable for Week 8. If he suits up, fantasy managers should play him. He faces a Ravens defense that has allowed the third-most WR yards. When these teams matched up last season, they combined for 81 points. You want exposure to this game.

Ja'Marr Chase, WR, Bengals (ankle): Chase is dealing with a minor ankle injury but will play this weekend and be a focal part of the Bengals' offensive attack. As always, if Chase plays for the Bengals, he is a must-start in fantasy football.

articles.headline: Harry Kane parades Ballon d'Or in front of Bayern Munich fans before Borussia Dortmund clash
articles.description: Harry Kane paraded the Ballon d'Or in front of fans at the Allianz Arena before Bayern Munich's game against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday, his first appearance since winning the award.
articles.body:
Harry Kane paraded the Ballon d'Or in front of fans at the Allianz Arena before Bayern Munich's game against Borussia Dortmund on Saturday, his first appearance since winning the award.

The England captain -- alongside wife Katie and his four children -- was applauded onto the pitch by both sets of players ahead of Der Klassiker, while 'Land of Hope and Glory' played over the PA system.

"I'm extremely proud to be a Bayern player," Kane said in his address to the crowd. "I hope we win many more titles together."

The ceremony took place after a golden banner featuring an image of Kane was unfurled in the centre circle, alongside graphics on the video screen and the advertising boards.

When walking onto the pitch, the Englishman was referred to by the stadium announcer as "the best footballer in the world, Harry Kane!"

On Monday, the 33-year-old became the first Englishman since Michael Owen in 2001 to win the prestigious award, after an incredible 2025-26 season in which he scored 73 goals for club and country.

He received a guard of honour from his teammates before Wednesday's 5-1 German Cup win over second-tier FC Magdeburg on Wednesday, but did not come off the bench in that game.

In beating the likes of Kylian Mbappé and Lamine Yamal, Kane became the fourth Bayern player to win the Ballon d'Or after Franz Beckenbauer, Gerd Müller and Karl-Heinz Rummenigge.

- 2026 Ballon d'Or results: Kane beat Mbappé by one of smallest margins in history

- Borussia Dortmund must stop Bayern's 'sensational' Harry Kane - Kovac

- Harry Kane knighthood? It would be 'weird' to be called Sir

Saturday's Klassiker began with both teams level on 17 points at the top of the Bundesliga table.

Konrad Laimer's first-half goal had Bayern 1-0 up at the break, after Jobe Bellingham's opener had been ruled out by VAR.

articles.headline: LeBron James, Joel Embiid both out for 76ers vs. Hornets
articles.description: LeBron James and Joel Embiid are out for the Sixers on Saturday in the second game of a back-to-back. It's the first time Philly is without both players at the same time.
articles.body:
Philadelphia 76ers stars LeBron James and Joel Embiid will miss Saturday's road game against the Charlotte Hornets with injury management, the team announced.

James's injury designation is low back/sciatica and Embiid's is right foot plantar fasciitis.

Charlotte is Philadelphia's second back-to-back of the season; it's expected that the Sixers will continue to be cautious with playing Embiid and James on back-to-backs as they navigate a long season.

Still, this will be the first game that these two miss together. Each has missed one game with injury management, but not simultaneously so far this season. Jaylen Brown, who missed Friday night's home win over the New York Knicks with a left patella injury, is listed as questionable.

Center Tacko Fall (quad) and forward/center Jabari Walker (knee) were listed as questionable. Fall hasn't played a game yet this season, and Walker hasn't played since injuring his knee in the team's win against the Milwaukee Bucks last Saturday.

Coach Nick Nurse said James had his "best game" of the season in Friday night's win over the Knicks. It was his first 20-point game as a Sixer, as he finished with 20 points, nine rebounds and eight assists.

articles.headline: Sources: Thunder no longer signing Ochai Agbaji following Chet Holmgren injury
articles.description: The Thunder are no longer signing free agent Ochai Agbaji as the franchise takes a step back to reevaluate its open roster spot after losing Chet Holmgren for two-plus months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.
articles.headlineJa: 【関係者】チェット・ホルムグレンの負傷により、サンダーはオチャイ・アグバジの獲得を断念
articles.descriptionJa: チェット・ホルムグレンが2ヶ月以上の離脱となるため、サンダーはロスターの空き枠を再評価することになり、フリーエージェントのオチャイ・アグバジの獲得を見送ると関係者がESPNのシャムス・チャラニアに語った。
articles.body:
The Oklahoma City Thunder are no longer signing free agent Ochai Agbaji as the franchise takes a step back to reevaluate its open roster spot after losing Chet Holmgren for two-plus months, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

Oklahoma City had agreed Friday to sign Agbaji to fill its open roster spot after major injuries to guard Cason Wallace and forward Jalen Williams, but then the Thunder decided to reconsider the options following the determination that Holmgren would also be out for an extended period.

Agbaji's health was not a concern or factor in the decision, sources said.

Agbaji, the No. 14 pick in the 2022 draft, has averaged 7.2 points and 2.7 rebounds in 263 games, including 108 starts. Agbaji, 26, was waived by the New York Knicks in final roster cuts this month. He has played for three NBA teams in his four years, splitting last season with the Toronto Raptors and Brooklyn Nets. Williams (fractured fibula, dislocated left ankle) and Wallace (torn labrum in left shoulder) both suffered injuries during Sunday's win over the LA Clippers that required surgery. Their recoveries will both take several months, but the Thunder have not ruled either player out for the season.

OKC expects Holmgren to return in eight to 10 weeks after undergoing biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear.

articles.headline: Saturday's fantasy basketball adds, NBA bets to make: Look to OKC's frontcourt
articles.description: Jim McCormick breaks down Saturday's NBA slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.
articles.body:
ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

What you need to know for Saturday

The NBA celebrates Halloween by featuring teams named after birds, bugs, bears, wolves, and even a type of music during today's seven-game slate.

A spooky element of Saturday's schedule is the heavy influence of injuries, even though it is still October. The Minnesota Timberwolves, for instance, are without offensive anchor Anthony Edwards for multiple months and are consequently massive underdogs against the San Antonio Spurs tonight. The Utah Jazz are without two important big men, while a hamstring injury to Ja Morant will change the Portland Trail Blazers' rotation in this matchup with Utah.

The Oklahoma City Thunder have been hit with waves of impactful injuries, the latest being All-Star pivot Chet Holmgren, who is sidelined for at least two months with a knee issue. Ajay Mitchell has already surfaced as a fantasy force in place of Jalen Williams, while a rookie center is relevant for today's game against the Houston Rockets.

This game in Houston (218.5) and tonight's meeting between the Philadelphia 76ers and Charlotte Hornets (215.5) both sport distinctly low point totals, serving as clear outliers among the other contests.

We can still identify helpful fantasy players and prop plays from these games, but the lower offensive ceilings should be noted when building DFS lineups. Through the lens of point totals, today's game in Charlotte is projected to have 12% fewer total points scored than tonight's meeting between the New Orleans Pelicans and Atlanta Hawks.

With an eye toward uncovering compelling betting angles and fantasy decisions, let's take a look at the day ahead in the NBA.

Fantasy stream team

Players available in at least 50% of leagues

Isaiah Hartenstein, C, Oklahoma City Thunder (rostered in 23.5% of ESPN leagues)

It's not often we promote with several big men from the same team, but Holmgren's absence creates a major void for high-value two-way minutes. Hartenstein won't produce the block rate of his injured peer, but awesome rebounding and fun passing results are on the way now that he's the primary big in the rotation.

Jeremiah Fears, SG/PG, New Orleans Pelicans (41.6%)

Finding paths to this game could prove rewarding. The massive point total is supported by fast pace and poor defensive metrics between these teams.
